summary.text: James Uhlenkamp is the Democratic candidate for Iowa State Senate District 9 in the November 3, 2026 general election, an open seat where he faces Republican Steve Baier.
Uhlenkamp previously ran for the Iowa House of Representatives in 2018.

paragraphs.text: Uhlenkamp was the Democratic nominee for Iowa House of Representatives District 24 in 2018, after advancing from the Democratic primary on June 5, 2018.
In the general election that year, incumbent Republican Cecil Dolecheck defeated him, 67.7 percent to 32.2 percent.
The Democratic primary for Senate District 9 scheduled for June 2, 2026 was canceled.
